name: Default landing on Attention
summary: Change the prototype default landing view from the Campaigns tab to the Attention tab.
scope: Default activeView on first load (and Reset demo) is Attention. Tab order, tab design, and all other Campaign Production behaviour remain unchanged from accepted v1.
preserve: Full Campaigns table → select row → in-situ split view → inspect → close → restore full table.
Campaign Production remains a control layer and wayfinder over CMS, DAM and Jira rather than replacing those systems.
Attention states are actionable and resolving an item updates surrounding workflow state.
Human checkpoints remain visible around consequential or uncertain automated steps.

validation.notes: Default landing on Attention verified locally via Studio proxy and direct Next route. Campaigns tab remains selectable and unchanged.
